name: helpers
eval: window.T={btn:(txt)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button,.item')].find(b=>(b.innerText||'').trim()===txt||b.title===txt||b.getAttribute('aria-label')===txt),ask:(q)=>{const a=document.querySelector('textarea');a.value=q;a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('button.send').click();},done:(n)=>{const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.message.assistant')];return m.length>=n&&!document.querySelector('.message.assistant.live')&&m[m.length-1].innerText.trim().length>0?m[m.length-1].innerText.trim():''},chats:()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.side-section')].map(s=>s.innerText)}; return true

name: agent file names
eval: const m=await import('/js/tools.js'); return ['a.command','b.exe','c.txt','d.app','e.sh '].map(m.fileNameOf)

name: no cuDNN in licenses

name: question 1

name: settings tabs
eval: const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog .tabs button')]; const out=[]; for (const b of tabs){b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); out.push(b.innerText.trim()+':'+document.querySelector('.dialog').innerText.length);} return out

name: restore helpers
eval: window.T={btn:(txt)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button,.item')].find(b=>(b.innerText||'').trim()===txt||b.title===txt||b.getAttribute('aria-label')===txt),ask:(q)=>{const a=document.querySelector('textarea');a.value=q;a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('button.send').click();},done:(n)=>{const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.message.assistant')];return m.length>=n&&!document.querySelector('.message.assistant.live')&&m[m.length-1].innerText.trim().length>0?m[m.length-1].innerText.trim():''}}; const a=document.querySelector('textarea'); a.value=''; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return true

name: new project
eval: document.querySelector('.item.new-item').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); d.querySelector('input').value='Projet essai'; [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return location.hash.startsWith('#/p/')

name: changelog dialog
eval: T.btn('Paramètres').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog .tabs button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='À propos').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog a')].find(a=>a.innerText.trim()==='Notes de version').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const ds=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog')]; return ds[ds.length-1].innerText.includes('4.11.0')

name: close dialogs
eval: for (let i=0;i<3;i++){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog button')].reverse().find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Fermer'); if(b){b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));}} return document.querySelectorAll('.dialog').length

name: licenses page
eval: location.hash='#/licenses'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); return document.querySelector('main').innerText.includes('Composants et licences') && document.querySelector('main').innerText.includes('Qwen3-VL 2B (essai)')

name: program licenses listed and readable
eval: const m=document.querySelector('main'); const has=['Albireo','dlib','Mbed TLS','SQLite','libjpeg'].every(n=>m.innerText.includes(n)); const b=[...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/Texte de la licence/.test(b.innerText+b.title)); if(!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return has && /Boost Software License|Permission/.test(m.innerText)

name: memory and data tabs
eval: location.hash='#/'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); T.btn('Paramètres').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const out=[]; for (const n of ['Mémoire','Données']){[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog .tabs button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()===n).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); out.push(document.querySelector('.dialog').innerText.length>200);} [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Fermer').click(); return out

eval: window.T={btn:(txt)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button,.item')].find(b=>(b.innerText||'').trim()===txt||b.title===txt),ask:(q)=>{const a=document.querySelector('textarea');a.value=q;a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('button.send').click();},done:(n)=>{const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.message.assistant')];return m.length>=n&&!document.querySelector('.message.assistant.live')&&m[m.length-1].innerText.trim().length>0?m[m.length-1].innerText.trim():''}}; return true

name: search
eval: const s=document.querySelector('.search input'); s.value='Italie'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); return document.querySelector('.side-scroll').innerText.slice(0,200)

name: clear search

name: project search dialog
eval: T.btn('Rechercher dans les projets').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); const inp=d.querySelector('input'); inp.value='essai'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); const txt=d.innerText; document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape'})); const b=[...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/Fermer|Annuler/.test(b.innerText)); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return txt.includes('Projet essai')
